citation: Takahashi et al. 2018. Four Plasma Glucose and Insulin Responses to a 75 g OGTT in Healthy Young Japanese Women. Journal of Diabetes Research 2018:5742497.
population: 62 healthy young Japanese women, age about 20.6, BMI about 21
note: Means printed per response-type subgroup (39, 11, 7, 5), not the whole group, so an overall mean must be pooled by n. Subgroups are defined by peak timing, so they differ by construction.
